title: A row context on Product does not filter Sales

source.quote: A row context does not propagate through relationships.
source.supports: the row context on Product does not propagate to Sales, so COUNTROWS ( Sales ) counts every row for each product

derivation: Product has 4 rows. For each, COUNTROWS ( Sales ) is evaluated in the empty filter context: 7. 4 * 7 = 28. With propagation it would be 3 + 2 + 2 = 7.
